decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that is very close to the firm's core salami know-how and stated growth direction, it fits existing absorptive capacity well and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

This product still builds on the firm's established processing and seasoning capabilities and the push into organic formats, but its narrower poultry-snack niche makes it somewhat more likely to be reviewed than the main salami lines.

A premium sharing salami snack line is closely related to the firm's existing competencies and broad assortment strategy, so the firm can readily learn from early market feedback and improve it rather than exit quickly.
